scope: Check extracted WrapFD device get/put ownership and dma-buf reference accounting.
limitations: Actual get/put bodies and device equality selector run with simulated file checks, device/dma-buf refcounts and locks. Covers 1..32 nested acquisitions, mismatched device/buffer and null arguments, and release ownership until final put. No kernel module caller, concurrent DMA, actual device removal or CFI indirect call executed.
